events.title: Meditation and Mindset Workshop – Brisbane (Day 1)
events.location: Pullman Brisbane King George Square, Brisbane City
events.description: This is the first day of a two-day personal development workshop in Brisbane CBD, focusing on practical meditation techniques and mindset training for enhanced wellbeing and performance in a small-group setting.

events.title: Meditation and Mindset Workshop – Brisbane (Day 2)
events.location: Pullman Brisbane King George Square, Brisbane City
events.description: This is the second and final day of the personal development workshop, continuing guided meditation practices and mindset coaching in a supportive small-group environment to deepen learning.

events.title: Brisbane Road Runners Club 10 Mile Championships
events.location: Brisbane Road Runners Club (West End riverside course), West End
events.description: This is a club-level 10-mile (16km) championship race along the Brisbane River pathways, hosted by the Brisbane Road Runners Club for participants of all distance running abilities.

events.title: Queensland Masters Athletics – Christmas in July Throws Competition Day 2
events.location: Queensland Sport and Athletics Centre, Nathan
events.description: This is the second day of a Masters-level throws meet (shot put, discus, etc.) at QSAC, organized by Queensland Masters Athletics with a festive 'Christmas in July' theme for active participants.

events.title: Diving Queensland – Sunday Splash
events.description: A community diving session hosted by Diving Queensland at Sleeman Sports Complex, offering practice and participation opportunities for individuals interested in diving.

events.title: Le Festival 2026 – Brisbane French Festival (Day 1)
events.description: The first day of Brisbane’s annual French cultural festival at Roma Street Parkland, featuring French food, wine, artisan markets, live music, and diverse francophone cultural experiences.

events.title: Le Festival 2026 – Brisbane French Festival (Day 2)
events.description: The second day of Le Festival continues with artisan stalls, diverse performances, gourmet tastings, and various French-themed cultural activities set within the beautiful Roma Street Parkland.

events.title: Le Festival 2026 – Brisbane French Festival (Day 3)
events.description: The final day of Brisbane’s French Festival offering another chance to experience gourmet food, enjoy live entertainment, explore cultural workshops, and immerse oneself in francophone culture.
